_comment: min_cuda_version is CUDA_VERSION read from each image's immutable OCI config (skopeo inspect --config, or the registry blob). min_compute_capability is the oldest GPU architecture that CUDA build supports: CUDA 13 dropped Maxwell, Pascal and Volta, so a CUDA 13 image needs Turing (7.5) or newer. Never guess either: a host that satisfies the driver but not the architecture rents and then fails to serve. Recheck both when bumping a digest.
